key_decisions.decision: Choose a leadership reading for the difficult first phrase with loose-hair alternative noted; preserve parallel willing action and blessing.
Keep the flowing/melting image and compressed this-Sinai expression instead of explaining a physical mechanism.
Preserve repeated cessation and first-person mother identity, with the difficult village term noted.
Keep new gods, gates, rhetorical weapons question and forty thousand without resolving difficult syntax silently.
Preserve three social/travel positions and the invitation to recount, with uncertain cloth term noted.
Choose singers and villagers with explicit lexical uncertainty in notes, retain righteousness and repeated acts.
Retain the difficult remnant/nobles relations and came-down repetition, with alternative syntax noted.
Keep the root image and all four tribal groups, retaining the ancient staff and role.
Retain my-leaders form, Issachar’s repeated name, passive sending, following-feet image and Reuben’s heart language; note compression.
Keep the rebuke, sheepfold and piping images, and the changed heart noun beside the repeated phrase.
Retain death-risk and the field heights, contrasting these groups with those who stayed.
Keep three watercourse references and the self-address, with ancient/onslaught uncertainty noted.
Keep curse, repeated divine-help phrase and uncertain among/against warriors relation in a note.
Keep both hands, implements and full violent verb sequence without replacing the poem with the prose account.
Preserve the feet, repeated collapse verbs and final devastation in their given order.
Retain the dehumanizing womb image for captive women, repeated plunder and textiles, and an explained reading of the difficult ending.
Preserve the prayer for enemies’ death, shift from your to him, sun image and separate narrator’s rest notice.
